plans.idea: Classic centred poster stack that mirrors the original's order (logo, bottle, headline, button) on one central axis, with the bottle given a clear gap above the type block so nothing touches.

Headline-led story format: brand mark, then the big two-line headline right under it, the bottle as the visual payoff in the middle, and the button anchored at the bottom so the eye runs headline to product to action.
Product-first with a sign-off footer: a large bottle fills the top half, the headline and button sit as one tight group below it, and the logo closes the ad at the bottom like a brand signature.
